subject: The Locus Coeruleus: A Tiny Brain Nucleus That Orchestrates Cognition and Predicts Neurodegeneration
script: From Agewell Brief: The Locus Coeruleus: A Tiny Brain Nucleus That Orchestrates Cognition and Predicts Neurodegeneration. New research reveals how a cluster of ~1,600 neurons in the brainstem governs attention, memory, and decision-making—and why its early decline may be the first domino in Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
